# M&Y Personal Injury Lawyers

> > Los Angeles-based personal injury law firm with $800M+ in recovered damages, specializing in car accidents, rideshare injuries, and catastrophic claims with 100+ years of combined attorney experience.

M&Y Personal Injury Lawyers is a prominent Los Angeles personal injury firm recognized by Super Lawyers, The National Trial Lawyers, and the Million Dollar Advocates Forum. The firm handles a wide range of accident and injury cases including motor vehicle accidents, rideshare incidents, premises liability, and wrongful death claims.
